sentences.en: She makes no allusion in the book to her profession.
sentences.zh: 她在书中没有提及她的职业。

sentences.en: They find me uncapable of following through with this profession.
sentences.zh: 他们认为我无法胜任这项工作。

sentences.en: There he continued his studies and work in various professions.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他继续在不同领域学习和工作。

senses.zh: （需要有高等教育学位的）职业（如医生或律师）
